The '''Pantoran emblem''' was the official symbol of the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]. [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] of the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]] wore the emblem on his [[Belt/Legends|belt]].
